advice_items.quote: You see somebody that's doing better than you and you would like to aspire to be them, steal what they're doing.
advice_items.summary_en: Study and model top performers in your field, then add your own twist.
advice_items.summary_zh: 观察并借鉴顶尖成功人士的做法，融入个人特色

advice_items.quote: It's easy to make a lot of money, it's hard to keep a lot of money. For those who are not financially literate, learn this word: annuity.
advice_items.summary_en: Making money is easy, keeping it is hard; build financial literacy and learn concepts like annuities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 赚钱容易守财难，务必学懂财务知识与年金

advice_items.quote: The common mistake business owners make is they think they know it all. Make sure you hire people that are smarter than you.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't think you know everything; hire people smarter than you and delegate to scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别自以为全懂，雇佣更聪明的人并学会授权

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: One piece of advice was to save 75% and have fun with 25%.
advice_items.summary_en: Save 75% of your earnings and limit fun or lifestyle spending to 25%.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将75%收入存下，只用25%消费享乐

advice_items.quote: Start high... if you start at 50 and their budget is 200, you just lost 150 million.
advice_items.summary_en: In negotiations, don't speak first and anchor high so you don't leave money on the table.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判时别先开口，报价应从高往低谈

advice_items.quote: I made a very big mistake the first time I got a million dollars, I spent it in about 30 minutes. Bought three cars, I bought three jewelries, and I bought some suits.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid blowing newfound wealth immediately on luxury cars, jewelry, and status symbols.
advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌暴富后立刻挥霍购买豪车与珠宝

advice_items.quote: The secret was just having special motivation. My motivation was always being able to get my mother what she wants.
advice_items.summary_en: Sustain longevity at the top by anchoring yourself to a deep personal motivation like providing for family.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拥有让家人过得更好的深层动力才能持久巅峰

advice_items.quote: Very important. None of this is possible without God.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and gratitude; recognize that success isn't achieved alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信仰与感恩，一切成就离不开上帝

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.quote: Not pulling the trigger when I had the opportunity to... Howard Schultz wanted to open Starbucks in the hood... I didn't pull the trigger.
advice_items.summary_en: Regrets hesitating and failing to pull the trigger on partnering with Starbucks early on.
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔当年犹豫未投资星巴克，错失良机

advice_items.quote: I think they're nice, I think they're humble, and I think they have great people around them, and they keep it very simple.
advice_items.summary_en: Highly successful people remain kind and humble, keep things simple, and surround themselves with great people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顶级成功者都谦逊友善且身边围绕优秀人才

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: Jeff Bezos said you invest in things that's going to change people's lives. I heard him say that and I changed my whole investment strategy and been very, very successful.
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt Jeff Bezos's principle: invest in businesses and innovations that change people's lives.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资真正能改变人们生活的事物与企业

advice_items.quote: I like to believe in what they believe in... if you told me your passion, I would definitely invest in you.
advice_items.summary_en: Build genuine passion and conviction in your venture, as that is what top investors back.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用真正的热情与信念打动投资人

advice_items.quote: Always believe, there will be ups and downs in this business, long you believe, quickly you'll make it to the top.
advice_items.summary_en: Write down your plan and maintain unwavering self-belief through the inevitable ups and downs.
advice_items.summary_zh: 写下计划，在商业起伏中始终坚定信念

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒，凭借NBA职业生涯赚取高额薪资与代言收入作为原始资本；拿到第一个100万美元时曾30分钟挥霍一空，随后自学金融理财并将体育收入杠杆化投资及特许经营（曾拥有155家Five Guys门店），建立庞大商业帝国。
guests.zero_start_advice: 有计划就先写下来；找到已经在做同类事情并取得成功的人，观察并借鉴（“偷师”）他们的做法，再加入自己的独特风格；商业必然有起有伏，只要始终保持信念，就能更快登上顶峰。
